registration.title: Different step sizes with and without xG
registration.what: Other values of the rank's step (K) for matches with xG and for matches without.
registration.why: The rank under-reacts slightly where there is no xG.
registration.how: A grid of the two step sizes on the selection window.
registration.hypothesis: Different step sizes improve the result probabilities.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The research round's bar (experiments/research_frame/REGISTER.md): better by 0.002 on the final period, the 99.6% interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by 0.0005, and 60% of competitions no worse.

events.label: Best setting on the selection window
events.meaningful: No. Under the 0.0002 a setting needed to be chosen, so it was not scored on the final period.
